result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but the second 'Popular right now' card is missing its name/rating/meta row, the bottom navigation bar contains a stray black bar overlapping an icon, and favorite-button styling is inconsistent between cards.

issues.description: The second card in 'Popular right now' (the pizza card with the -20% badge) shows only the image; the restaurant name, rating, delivery time/fee and cuisine text that appear on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card are absent, leaving an empty gap beneath the image.
issues.suggestion: Render the title, rating and meta line for every restaurant card, or hide the card until its data has loaded.

issues.description: In the bottom tab bar a long solid black horizontal bar spans across the middle, overlapping/obscuring the search icon and the third tab icon, making the tabs hard to identify and tap accurately.
issues.suggestion: Remove or reposition the stray element (likely a mis-sized divider/indicator) so each tab icon is fully visible and separated from the system gesture bar.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: white circular background on the ramen card and dark/translucent circular background on the pizza card.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite-button style (background, border and icon color) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: In 'Fastest near you' the first card image uses a light gray background while the neighboring cards use dark imagery, making the row look visually uneven.
issues.suggestion: Normalize card image treatment (consistent aspect ratio and background/overlay) so the carousel reads as one set.

issues.description: Bottom navigation icons have no text labels, and the promotional banner's secondary text ('Use code TALLINN3...') is low-contrast light green on green.
issues.suggestion: Add labels under tab icons and increase the banner subtitle contrast to meet WCAG AA.
